mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no, t.title, t.description, t.category_id, t.building_id, t.asset_id, t.category_name_snapshot AS category_name, t.building_name_snapshot AS building_name, t.asset_name_snapshot AS asset_name, t.room, t.priority, t.status, reporter.name AS reporter_name, assignee.name AS assignee_name, t.resolution, t.version, t.created_at, t.sla_due_at FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN sys_user reporter ON reporter.id = t.reporter_id LEFT JOIN sys_user assignee ON assignee.id = t.assignee_id WHERE t.id = #{ticketId}
SELECT file_url AS url FROM ticket_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND file_type = 'REPORT' ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT h.id, h.from_status, h.to_status, h.operator_id, operator.name AS operator_name, h.action, h.remark, h.created_at FROM ticket_history h LEFT JOIN sys_user operator ON operator.id = h.operator_id WHERE h.ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY h.event_version ASC, h.id ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE ticket
ticket_no = #{ticketNo},
AND (reporter.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reporterKeyword}, '%') OR reporter.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reporterKeyword}, '%'))
AND (assignee.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assigneeKeyword}, '%') OR assignee.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{assigneeKeyword}, '%'))
reporter_id = #{reporterId}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, category_id = #{categoryId}, building_id = #{buildingId}, asset_id = #{assetId}, category_name_snapshot = #{categoryNameSnapshot}, building_name_snapshot = #{buildingNameSnapshot}, asset_name_snapshot = #{assetNameSnapshot}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, room = #{room}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, resolution = #{resolution}, sla_due_at = #{slaDueAt}, created_at = #{createdAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
